meta.name: conversion-signal-qa
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "QA my conversion tracking before launch", "check my UTMs / pixel / event firing", "set up a tracking pre-flight", or "set the dedup rule so Meta and Google stop double-counting"; builds and fixes the measurement plumbing — conversion-event firing, UTM hygiene, cross-platform dedup rules, attribution-window alignment, and offline/iOS-ATT modeled-gap flags — as a pre-flight checklist plus a UTM/event-spec builder. Not for scoring R1/R2 — that is a scored veto in ad-account-auditor; not for account structure — use campaign-architect. 付费广告转化追踪QA/UTM规范/跨平台去重

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复广告转化追踪的配置问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果投放广告时需要确保转化数据准确无误
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix conversion tracking issues before launch
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure accurate conversion tracking for your ad campaigns

howto.what: Claude 会检查付费广告的转化追踪是否正常，包括转化事件触发、UTM 参数规范、跨平台去重规则、归因窗口对齐，以及离线/iOS-ATT 建模缺口。它会生成一份预飞检查清单和 UTM/事件规范表，并指出需要修复的问题。
howto.when: 当你要求“QA 我的转化追踪”、“检查 UTM/像素/事件触发”、“设置追踪预飞”或“设置去重规则”时触发。

say.text: QA 我的转化追踪，平台是 Google 和 Meta。
say.note: Claude 会检查转化事件触发、UTM 等。

say.text: 帮我建一个 UTM 方案和事件规范，再给一份预飞检查清单。
say.note: Claude 会生成命名规范和事件表。

say.text: 我的 Meta 和 Google 数据与 GA4 订单对不上，找出问题。
say.note: Claude 会检查去重、归因窗口和 UTM 问题。

howto.what_en: Claude checks paid ad conversion tracking: event firing, UTM hygiene, cross-platform dedup rules, attribution-window alignment, and offline/iOS-ATT modeled gaps. It produces a pre-flight checklist and a UTM/event spec, flagging issues to fix.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "QA my conversion tracking", "check my UTMs / pixel / event firing", "set up a tracking pre-flight", or "set the dedup rule".

say_en.text: QA my conversion tracking for Google and Meta.
say_en.note: Claude checks event firing, UTMs, etc.

say_en.text: Build a UTM scheme and event spec, then give me a pre-launch checklist.
say_en.note: Claude generates naming convention and event table.

say_en.text: My Meta and Google numbers don't match GA4 orders — find the problems.
say_en.note: Claude checks dedup, windows, and UTMs.
